text_blocks.snippet: The COVID-19 pandemic, caused by the virus SARS-CoV-2, began in Wuhan, China in December 2019. It rapidly spread worldwide, leading to the World Health Organization (WHO) declaring it a pandemic on March 11, 2020.

list.snippet: Symptoms: Fever, cough, fatigue, shortness of breath, loss of taste or smell
Transmission: Through respiratory droplets from infected individuals or contaminated surfaces

text_blocks.snippet: As of July 17, 2025, the COVID-19 pandemic continues to affect many parts of the world. New variants of the virus continue to emerge, and vaccination efforts are ongoing. The number of cases, hospitalizations, and deaths has fluctuated over time, but the virus remains a significant public health concern.

list.snippet: Wear a mask: Wear a well-fitting mask in public indoor settings.
Practice good hand hygiene: Wash your hands frequently with soap and water or use hand sanitizer.
Maintain social distancing: Stay at least 6 feet away from others, especially if they are sick.
Check your local public health department website for updates.
